gene_recommendations.name: PREFILL
gene_recommendations.argument_from_code: On HEAD the native resident already has a named prefill_wall_ns and a prompt loop, but the arithmetic is decode (GEMV, 964 dispatches/token, quadratic GQA). The unmerged 8391a0ef8 work is a different physical program: different shaders, different workspace, different encode_* functions, different env gate, different tests. I-D already lists 'phase-aware backend selection'; that gene is the right parent and is currently unexpressed as a shipped backend. II-D is about non-weight structures (KV, tokenizer, sampling, LM head as an organ). Prefill-as-GEMM is a weight-execution phase, not a state organ. Putting PREFILL only under II-D would hide the kernel/forge work. Adding a sixth era or a new civilization is forbidden.
existing_gene_overlap: 11.3 school item 'Phase-aware prefill vs decode backends' (not a gene)
gene_recommendations.recommendation: Name PREFILL as an explicit I-D gene (or rename 'phase-aware backend selection' to include PREFILL as the first expressed phase). Do not rewrite the 0.7% coordinate. Do not merge the unmerged branch as part of this audit.

gene_recommendations.name: Context Computer / Context Gravity
gene_recommendations.argument_from_code: Two different things share the word context. (1) crates/hawking-context ContextCompiler is INTEGRATED into hide-backend/hide-kernel as a prompt packer; HCLI context_budget is INTEGRATED. That is product, not a missing gene. (2) GPU session state gravity (KV bytes that grow with seq, DeltaNet rec_state that does not, crossover where state overtakes weights) is measured in PREFILL_KV / STATE_GRAVITY and lives in Qwen38 workspace buffers, but is not a compiler that chooses a representation. Inventing a 'Context Computer' civilization would violate the five-era constitution and duplicate HIDE. II-D already has KV/state compression, persistent recurrent state, and long-context policy.
gene_recommendations.recommendation: Do not add Context Computer as a civilization or gene. If a name is needed for the GPU-state accounting organ, express the existing II-D genes rather than minting a fourth. Keep hawking-context under product/HIDE, not under Accelerator.

gene_recommendations.name: DeltaNet-state checkpoint+reuse
gene_recommendations.argument_from_code: II-D already lists 'persistent recurrent state'. The code does not express it: sstate_disk has no callers, generate_greedy always reset(), G007 receipt is absent. A new gene with the same meaning would be nomenclature inflation. The verifier already exists as a red gate.
gene_recommendations.recommendation: Do not add a gene. Express 'persistent recurrent state' by wiring a real checkpoint/restore that generate_greedy (or a resume entry) actually calls, then discharge G007. Until a caller exists, the gene is unexpressed, not missing from the list.

gene_recommendations.name: KV/state tiering
gene_recommendations.argument_from_code: Compression (II-D KV/state compression) and tiering (where the bytes live: GPU / RAM / disk) are different physical decisions. QwenDense generate() already has RAM+disk prefix tiers with real callers. hawking-serve has SystemPromptKvBank. The native Qwen38 resident has neither: one GPU workspace, reset every request. That split is load-bearing. A gene named only 'compression' will keep scheduling quant recipes (STATE_GRAVITY's H2O/KIVI/rank-32, capability cost ABSENT) and miss the already-callable generic-engine tiers that the resident does not use.
gene_recommendations.recommendation: Yes, add an explicit II-D gene for state tiering (GPU/RAM/disk and prefix-bank vs full reset). Do not treat QwenDense's tiers as if they were on the native resident.

gene_recommendations.name: long-context physical accounting
gene_recommendations.argument_from_code: II-D already lists 'long-context policy'. G006 is the verifier (red). G118/PREFILL_KV are the school. The runtime does not expose a live meter on Qwen38HybridDecodeSession (no kv_bytes_per_token_source=measured in-process). The gene exists and is unexpressed as a live organ.
gene_recommendations.recommendation: Do not add a duplicate gene. Express 'long-context policy' as a live accounting object the resident returns per request (prefill_s, kv_bytes, rec_state_bytes, admitted_limit) so G006 can gate on a producer rather than a hand-written JSON.
